property.name: dfs.replication
property.description: Single DataNode deployment - no block replication.

property.name: dfs.namenode.name.dir
property.description: NameNode metadata directory (backed by the hdfs_namenode volume).

property.name: dfs.datanode.data.dir
property.description: DataNode block storage directory (backed by the hdfs_datanode volume).

property.name: dfs.namenode.rpc-address
property.description: HDFS RPC endpoint advertised to clients.

property.name: dfs.webhdfs.enabled
property.description: Enable WebHDFS REST API (used by the backend for on-demand reads).

property.name: dfs.datanode.du.reserved
property.description: Reserve 1 GiB of local disk for the host OS.
